title: Battle of Jarte
text: The Battle of Jarte was fought from 4 to 16 April 1542 between the forces of Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi and the Ethiopian Empire assisted by a Portuguese expeditionary force led by Cristóvão da Gama. The Abyssinians and Portuguese were victorious, with Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi wounded by the outnumbered Christian force, and the Adalites forced to retreat.
